verdict.rationale: Unit is a banking-as-a-service platform covering ACH, cards and accounts, so fraud-loss liability allocation and prevention tooling is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack addresses who absorbs ACH return fraud, card disputes or account-takeover losses. Nor does it document any fraud-prevention tooling. The card controls and real-time authorization mentions are generic product features, not fraud economics or a liability split.
